narratives.body: ESPN discusses AC Milan backing a fan boycott over away ticket prices described as excessive. FOX Sports discusses AC Milan backing a fan boycott over away ticket prices described as excessive and warning of retaliation.
narratives.headline: AC Milan supports fan boycott over ticket prices

narratives.headline: Milan faces uncertainty regarding Chukwueze and Athekame's status

narratives.headline: AC Milan seeks new contract for Rabiot
